We booked the entire Luminary Dynasty House while attending a friend’s wedding and it worked out perfectly for our group of friends, including ladies and children. The house felt safe, comfortable and homely, with plenty of space for everyone to relax and get ready together.The property is well maintained, clean and in a calm residential area, yet conveniently located for getting around the city. The common areas are spacious and ideal for hanging out as a group, and the rooms are comfortable for a longer stay.The host truly made a difference to our experience – she was very helpful and friendly throughout, always easy to talk to and quick to respond whenever we needed anything. From coordinating our check‑in to accommodating small requests during the wedding functions, she handled everything with a positive attitude and a smile.Overall, a very smooth and enjoyable stay, and we would happily choose Luminary Dynasty House again for a future trip or family event.
